commentary.text: 95' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) picks up a yellow card.
90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Frosinone concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
90+1' A player from Frosinone commits a rough challenge. Luca Pairetto blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
86' That's the end of the game for Olivier Giroud, who is replaced by Yunus Musah (AC Milan).
86' Substitution. Davide Calabria leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marco Brescianini trots off the pitch and is replaced by Reinier (Frosinone).
85' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Luca Mazzitelli will be replaced by Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone).
85' AC Milan control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
81' 2 - 3 Goal! Luka Jovic (AC Milan) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 2:3.
80' A substitution has been made. Christian Pulisic is replaced by Luka Jovic (AC Milan).
77' Here's the change. Abdou Harroui leaves the pitch and Pol Lirola (Frosinone) comes on as a substitute.
77' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Demba Seck and he is replaced by Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone).
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Kaio Jorge as he is replaced by Walid Cheddira (Frosinone).
75' AC Milan enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
72' 2 - 2 GOAL! Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) scores with a header from close range after Olivier Giroud headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 2:2.
72' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
70' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Luca Pairetto blows for a foul.
69' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) sends a long ball in, but Stefano Turati comfortably gathers the ball.
69' Great teamplay by AC Milan as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

65' 2 - 1 Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Mike Maignan is just a bystander as the ball flies low into the middle of the goal. The score is 2:1.
64' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:7. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:3.
62' Stefano Pioli prepares a substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek is replaced by Noah Okafor (AC Milan).
62' Substitution. Tijjani Reijnders makes his way off the pitch and Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) comes on as his replacement.
61' A player from AC Milan commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
61' The ball is out of play. AC Milan win a corner kick.
61' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
60' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
59' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.

57' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' A player from AC Milan commits a rough challenge. Luca Pairetto blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
51' The AC Milan players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) has tested the patience of referee Luca Pairetto and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
47' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Frosinone is cautioned for aggressive play.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman signals a throw-in for AC Milan.
43' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.
42' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
42' Looks like Davide Calabria (AC Milan) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
41' AC Milan are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
37' Demba Seck (Frosinone) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
36' The game is interrupted now, Demba Seck (Frosinone) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' A cross by Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
33' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
32' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
31' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

30' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
26' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AC Milan.
24' 1 - 1 Goal! Matias Soule (Frosinone) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mike Maignan into left side of the goal.
24' Matias Soule (Frosinone) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
23' Referee Luca Pairetto is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Frosinone!
23' Celebrations by Frosinone are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
22' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Rafael Leao (AC Milan) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Frosinone.
21' Matias Soule (Frosinone) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
21' Demba Seck (Frosinone) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal and forces the goalkeeper to make a great save. The ball goes out of play. Frosinone are awarded a corner kick.
18' Referee Luca Pairetto points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) goes wild in celebration.
18' The AC Milan players halt their celebrations as referee Luca Pairetto makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
17' 0 - 1 Goal! Rafael Leao picks out Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom right corner with a header from close range. 0:1.
16' The ball falls kindly for Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
15' A player from Frosinone commits a rough challenge. Luca Pairetto blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
13' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' Matias Soule (Frosinone) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
11' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. AC Milan will have a throw-in.
9' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) passes the ball onto Olivier Giroud, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
7' Luca Pairetto interrupts the game. One of the players from Frosinone won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
6' Neat passing move from AC Milan in order to create new attacking opportunities.
4' The ball is cleared after Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

1' Matias Soule (Frosinone) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Frosinone will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Luca Pairetto.
